facts.fact: Antonio 六岁，Flesh 里母亲只在必须时才亲他，Dream 里他属于一个部落
facts.anchor: Antonio is six years old and his mother kisses him only when she has to

facts.fact: 斥候看见海盗大帆船起锚复航，战争不是第一场但可能是最后一场，Antonio 觉得好玩
facts.anchor: The scouts have seen the pirate galleon raise anchor and resume sailing

facts.fact: Wendy 梦见自己裸体在海面上飞，头戴礼帽，帽里是否有兔子成了她自己的悬念
facts.anchor: Now the Wondrous Wendy dreams of being naked, with a top hat on her head (will it contain a rabbit?)

facts.fact: 深夜电话把 Wendy 从 Dream 拽回 Flesh，她第一反应是父亲出事
facts.anchor: The phone never brings good news at this time

facts.fact: Wendy 靠职业本能读出 Giada 的情绪是恐惧，被叫去她家
facts.anchor: What Giada was feeling was fear

facts.fact: 78 岁萨克斯手 Tito 的俱乐部不足一周就关门，他只剩四次拉卷帘门
facts.anchor: Tito will get to shut up the club just four more times

facts.fact: 一月底寒夜里一个不穿鞋的少女在门口搭话，是她今晚五个观众之一
facts.anchor: She’s a strange one, going around with no shoes on, despite the cold of late January

facts.fact: 少女替一个「办活动」的人邀约 Tito，说正计划最大的一场
facts.anchor: He organises events, and he’s planning the biggest of all

facts.fact: Giada 说在垃圾里找到收藏的决定性一件，即那尊断像的原件
facts.anchor: I found the definitive piece of my collection

facts.fact: 浴缸里是个非人非兽的男胎：额上两角、褐色长爪、软骨眼睑、多齿裂吻、山羊腿与蹄，约三十厘米
facts.anchor: On the crest of the forehead sprout two bony, sharp protuberances, little horns pointed like skewers

facts.fact: Wendy 用魔术师的方法闭眼再看，确认它不是道具；Wonder 现出怪诞面目，她随后说它是魔鬼，Giada 说或是它的孩子
facts.anchor: The foetus is made of real flesh, it has real bones, and it seems fake only because it’s too real

facts.fact: Giada 刚说完它有角和六英寸的阴茎，胎儿就睁开眼睛；它爬出浴缸，Giada 拿发胶喷它被躲开
Michele 在旧衣柜领带架后打开父亲藏的三平米暗室，里面是雨后树林般的浓烈气味
facts.anchor: Michele enters the Secret. He is welcomed by an intense smell of trees

facts.fact: 失踪的父亲在暗室最里面，把封面画着一整圆加左右两段弧线的黑笔记本递给 Michele，双脚沾着新鲜的泥
facts.anchor: Papa’s clasping a little book in his hands, clasping it to his chest like a newborn baby

facts.fact: 反被锁进浴室：孩子在外大人在内；两人跟到厨房门外的咀嚼声，Wendy 赶走恐惧开灯，本章在此结束
facts.anchor: The Wondrous Wendy casts out fear
